_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "servings_numerator" INTEGER NOT NULL, "servings_denominator" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_ref" TEXT NULL, "prep_time_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "cook_time_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "total_time_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source_url" TEXT NULL, "source_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ingredient_sections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ingredient_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "section_id" TEXT NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_numerator" INTEGER NULL, "quantity_denominator" INTEGER NULL, "quantity_max_numerator" INTEGER NULL, "quantity_max_denominator" INTEGER NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "preparation" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "step_sections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_steps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "section_id" TEXT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "folders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "folder_entries" ("folder_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("folder_id", "recipe_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_nutrients" ("food_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nutrient_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("food_id", "nutrient_code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_portions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_numerator" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_denominator" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gram_weight" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_matches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ingredient_line_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "gram_weight" REAL NOT NULL, "user_confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_confirmed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_versions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "experiments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "working_recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "change_description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "shared_with_others" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("shared_with_others" IN (0, 1)), "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "grocery_lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "grocery_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_numerator" INTEGER NULL, "quantity_denominator" INTEGER NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "store_section" TEXT NULL, "checked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("checked" IN (0, 1)), "source_ingredient_line_id" TEXT NULL, "source_recipe_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measuring_tools" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "capacity_numerator" INTEGER NOT NULL, "capacity_denominator" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_recipe_prefs" ("recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "servings_numerator" INTEGER NOT NULL, "servings_denominator" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_system" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("recipe_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "change_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("transport_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "pull_cursor" TEXT NULL, "pushed_through_hlc" TEXT NULL, "last_synced_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("transport_key"));
CREATE INDEX ingredient_sections_recipe ON ingredient_sections (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX ingredient_lines_recipe ON ingredient_lines (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX step_sections_recipe ON step_sections (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX recipe_steps_recipe ON recipe_steps (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX folder_entries_recipe ON folder_entries (recipe_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX foods_source_external ON foods (source, external_id)
CREATE INDEX food_portions_food ON food_portions (food_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nutrition_matches_line ON nutrition_matches (ingredient_line_id)
CREATE INDEX recipe_versions_recipe ON recipe_versions (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX experiments_recipe ON experiments (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX grocery_items_list ON grocery_items (list_id)
CREATE INDEX change_log_field ON change_log (entity, entity_id, field)
CREATE INDEX change_log_hlc ON change_log (hlc)
